name: Commercial Equipment Service Inc.
old_description: When you own or operate a restaurant or other commercial facility that relies on complex equipment for refrigeration, cooking and other key aspects of your business, you count on that equipment to operate reliably. When you have a problem with your equipment, you need a commercial refrigeration contractor in Wilmington, Edgemoor, or Elsmere, DE who can provide fast, effective and dependable repairs. This is where our commercial and industrial HVAC company enters the picture. Since 1984, our team has provided commercial appliance repair services as well as restaurant equipment sales in Delaware, and we pride ourselves on the quality of our workmanship and customer service. For HVACR, cooking and refrigeration systems in Delaware, there’s no better name in the industry.
about:
Commercial Equipment Service Inc. has operated from Wilmington, Delaware since 1984. Founded as a local contractor, the company began by offering commercial appliance repair and restaurant equipment sales to businesses across the state, building a reputation for responsive service in the Mid-Atlantic region.

Today the firm provides HVAC installation, commercial refrigeration repair, and cooking equipment maintenance for restaurants and other commercial facilities. Technicians are dispatched 24 hours a day for emergency breakdowns, and the company also stocks and sells replacement restaurant equipment such as reach-in coolers, fryers, and ventilation hoods.

The customer base includes independent restaurants, hotel kitchens, institutional cafeterias, industrial facilities, and commercial property managers throughout Delaware who depend on reliable refrigeration, cooking, and HVACR systems. Service calls cover Wilmington, Edgemoor, Elsmere, and the surrounding New Castle County area.

The company cites its round-the-clock availability, quick turnaround on repairs, and consistent workmanship as the factors that set it apart, aiming to minimize downtime for operators who cannot afford extended equipment outages.
